decisions.reason: Analytics isolation is a separate requirement and is already captured by its own message-55 MODIFY; the booking-specific change adds no analytics state change.
Staff-access isolation is independently established by its message-55 INTRODUCE and is not changed by the booking activation rule.
The existing rule that each location has its own payment setup already covers Ridgehaven; temporarily disabling customer booking does not change payment-processing isolation.
Customer-database isolation is independently captured by its message-55 INTRODUCE and remains unchanged by the booking-specific modification.
Gift-card isolation is independently captured by its message-55 INTRODUCE; booking activation timing does not alter gift-card management.
The existing per-location Wix-account model already includes Ridgehaven, so the source decision confirms rather than changes this requirement.
Ridgehaven-specific payout isolation is already present in the candidate state, and the booking activation rule does not modify payout behavior.
The source booking modification neither changes nor removes the existing rule that each location maintains its own calendar.
Membership isolation is independently captured by its message-55 INTRODUCE and is unaffected by when Ridgehaven booking is enabled.
The existing separate-location website model remains valid unchanged; a separate Wix account and delayed booking activation do not require a website-model update.
The candidate's message-55 INTRODUCE already records the coming-soon state and the transition to enable booking at opening, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
VIP signup remains enabled during the coming-soon phase and is not changed by the separate rule keeping customer booking off until opening.
